title: lobelia pusilla
intro: Lobelia pusilla, commonly known as Lobelia, is a perennial plant belonging to the Campanulaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in respiratory issues and relieve coughs, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia include its stimulant and expectorant properties, which help to increase respiratory function and ease congestion. The bioactive constituents of Lobelia include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
